title: Received photos · native library chrome
expect: Production uses tile transitions and contextual selection.
Grid paging, media keys and scroll survive viewing and returning.
Only the photo changes bounds between tile and viewer; no whole-page scale or photo fade.
Contextual title, menu and close icon use readable surface/on-surface roles in light and dark.
Selected tiles inset with rounded corners and a top-start primary circle with an on-primary check; other tiles show outline circles only during selection.
Return adopts the source status/navigation icon appearance at transition start.
A laid-out tile poster releases entry before any full-size request; slow or failed decoding keeps the poster visible.
Animator duration scale zero opens and closes immediately with the tile poster visible.

actions.result: System selection and contextual View, applicable Retry and Share.
System shared-element flight returns to the same tile.

actions.action: Open a cause group, select and view a tile, then Back
actions.result: Cause grid stays open with independent selection and scroll.
